title: Aromatic Smoky Vietnamese Red Peppers Lotus-Leaf-Wrapped Banh-Mi
description: A smoky, springy, energizing Vietnamese dish featuring sweet red peppers wrapped in fragrant lotus leaves.
name: Pickled ginger
instructions: Slice the red bell peppers and place them on a baking sheet.
Broil the red bell peppers for 3 minutes on each side.
In a pan, melt 1 tablespoon of butter over medium heat.
Add 1 tablespoon of grated ginger and 1 tablespoon of fish sauce to the pan and stir until combined.
Add the sliced chicken breast to the pan and cook for 2 minutes on each side.
Add 1 tablespoon of lime juice and 1 tablespoon of chopped cilantro to the pan and stir until combined.
Slice the picked carrots and daikon radish.
Assemble the bánh mì by placing a slice of chicken breast, a slice of red bell pepper, a slice of picked carrot, and a slice of daikon radish on each bánh mì.
Optional: add a slice of pickled ginger on top of the bánh mì.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
